title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 99
description: Ten questions on Psalms 99: the holy King enthroned among the cherubim, who answered Moses, Aaron and Samuel.

questions.text: Where does Yahweh sit enthroned, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he sits enthroned among the cherubim.

answers.text: In the gates of the city

questions.text: Where is Yahweh great, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "Yahweh is great in Zion."

questions.text: What exclamation follows the call to praise his great and awesome name?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!"

questions.text: What does the King's strength love, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "The King's strength also loves justice."

questions.text: Where does verse 5 say to worship?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool."

questions.text: Who were among his priests, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Moses and Aaron were among his priests.

questions.text: What does verse 6 say about Samuel?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Samuel was among those who call on his name.

answers.text: He built the temple of Yahweh
He led the army into battle
He wrote down all the law
He was among those calling on his name

questions.text: In what did Yahweh speak to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says he spoke to them in the pillar of cloud.

questions.text: Verse 8 calls Yahweh a God who forgave them, although what?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he forgave them, although he took vengeance for their doings.

answers.text: They lived far away in Egypt
He took vengeance for their doings
They had no priests among them

questions.text: Where does verse 9 say to worship?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!"
